2607.22718.title: DAMamba-UNet3D: A Parameter-Efficient Mamba State Space U-Net with Dynamic Adaptive Scan for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
2607.22718.paper_summary: We propose parameter-efficient SSM-based U-Net architectures for 3D medical image segmentation. Convolutional U-Nets afford O(n) local mixing per layer but lack explicit global context; transformers provide global reasoning at O(n^2) cost in sequence length $n$. State-space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, offer $O(n)$ global propagation per block. Yet, existing medical SSM segmenters rely on fixed scan patterns and large parameter budgets. Dynamic Adaptive Scan (DAS), which learns data-dependent reordering before selective scan, has not been applied to medical imaging or extended to 3D volumes. We propose DAMamba-UNet3D, a hybrid encoder-decoder that integrates tri-plane 3D-DAS blocks at encoder stages E2-E4 while retaining convolutions elsewhere (~5.3M parameters). On BraTS 2020 five-fold cross-validation, DAMamba-UNet3D achieves mean Dice 0.815+/-0.013 (full-volume per-case evaluation) at ~13x lower parameter cost than SegMamba (0.824+\-0.014, ~70M). At comparable scale, DAMamba-L (~70M), a wide DAS-native variant with encoder-only DAMamba and a convolutional bottleneck, reaches 0.829+\-0.012, surpassing retrained SegMamba by 0.5pt. Component ablations show that encoder-only DAS placement is critical as bottleneck and decoder SSM blocks lower Dice. Together, the results suggest that learned tri-plane DAS in a hybrid U-Net is competitive with, and under our large-scale design may improve upon, SegMamba's fixed Tri-orientated Mamba (ToM) scanning on BraTS 2020. Code: https://github.com/marafathussain/DAMamba-UNet3D.
2607.22718.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出基於參數效率的SSM的U-Net架構，用於3D醫學影像分割。卷積U-Net每層提供O(n)的局部混合，但缺乏明確的全局上下文；Transformer在序列長度$n$上提供O(n^2)的全局推理。狀態空間模型（SSM），如Mamba，提供每個區塊$O(n)$的全局傳播。然而，現有的醫學SSM分割器依賴於固定的掃描模式和大型參數預算。動態自適應掃描（DAS）在選擇性掃描之前學習數據依賴的重排序，但尚未應用於醫學影像或擴展到3D體積。我們提出DAMamba-UNet3D，一種混合編碼器-解碼器，將三平面3D-DAS區塊集成在編碼器階段E2-E4，同時在其他地方保留卷積（約5.3M參數）。在BraTS 2020的五折交叉驗證中，DAMamba-UNet3D以約13倍較低的參數成本達到平均Dice 0.815+/-0.013（每案例的全體積評估），相比之下SegMamba為0.824+/-0.014（約70M）。在可比規模下，DAMamba-L（約70M）是一種寬DAS原生變體，僅使用DAMamba作為編碼器並具有卷積瓶頸，達到0.829+/-0.012，超越重新訓練的SegMamba 0.5點。組件消融實驗顯示，僅編碼器的DAS放置作為瓶頸至關重要，而解碼器SSM區塊則降低了Dice。綜合結果表明，在混合U-Net中學習的三平面DAS具有競爭力，並且在我們的大規模設計下可能超越SegMamba的固定三向Mamba（ToM）掃描於BraTS 2020。代碼：https://github.com/marafathussain/DAMamba-UNet3D。
